commands.review_summary:
The PR adds an opt-in `models.providers.*.request.rateLimit` config surface, managed provider transport pacing and queue rejection, schema/help/label updates, focused tests, and a plugin SDK surface budget update.

PR surface: Source +213, Tests +264, Generated 0, Other 0. Total +477 across 13 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level. PR head throws `ProviderHttpError` for local queue-full inside the custom fetch, while OpenAI SDK v6.39.1 retries thrown custom-fetch errors as connection failures and OpenClaw's SDK clients do not disable those retries.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A repair worker can fix the narrow SDK retry semantics defect, but maintainers still need to approve the new config surface and provider-only scope before merge.

target.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Provider model requests can currently burst into an upstream API without a local pacing/backlog guard. This adds an opt-in provider/model/baseUrl request limiter for the model-provider HTTP dispatch path only: rolling requests-per-minute, minimum inter-dispatch spacing, and bounded local queue rejection.

This is a focused provider-dispatch slice of the broader rate-limit tracker; tool/channel calls, budgets, metrics, backoff, and CLI/status UX remain out of scope here.

Refs #13615.

## Summary
- add `models.providers.*.request.rateLimit` schema/types/help for provider-scoped request pacing
- route rate-limited provider models through the managed OpenClaw transport seam
- add local per provider/model/baseUrl request buckets with rolling RPM, minimum interval, and bounded queue rejection
- fix review blockers: typed transport mock, abort waits reject with `Error`, `maxQueueSize: 0` allows immediate dispatch while rejecting requests that would queue, and inert `maxQueueSize`-only configs are rejected/dropped
- satisfy plugin SDK public surface budget after the new model request type export

## Evidence

Real local transport proof using a temporary HTTP server and `buildGuardedModelFetch` with provider request metadata:

```text
$ node --import tsx /tmp/openclaw-rate-limit-proof.ts
pacing: hits=2 gapMs=218 result=PASS
rejection: hits=1 status=429 code=provider_rate_limit_queue_full result=PASS
```

Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests  122 passed (122)

$ OPENCLAW_VITEST_NO_OUTPUT_TIMEOUT_MS=600000 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.runtime-config.config.ts src/config/zod-schema.models.test.ts --testNamePattern "model-provider request rate limits" --reporter verbose
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  3 passed | 18 skipped (21)

$ OPENCLAW_VITEST_NO_OUTPUT_TIMEOUT_MS=600000 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.tooling.config.ts test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter verbose
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  8 passed (8)

$ node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check
package-exported forbidden subpaths: 0
# exit 0

$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.agents.json --noEmit --pretty false --singleThreaded --checkers 1
tsgo_exit:0

$ ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/agents/provider-request-config.ts src/agents/provider-request-config.test.ts src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.ts src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.test.ts src/agents/provider-transport-stream.ts src/agents/provider-transport-stream.test.ts src/config/zod-schema.core.ts src/config/zod-schema.models.test.ts scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.

$ ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/provider-request-config.ts src/agents/provider-request-config.test.ts src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.ts src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.test.ts src/agents/provider-transport-stream.ts src/agents/provider-transport-stream.test.ts src/config/zod-schema.core.ts src/config/zod-schema.models.test.ts scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs
